 November 03, 2026 at 6:00 am CST Expand cristina castro (Capitol News Illinois photo by Andrew Campbell)
 Buy Photo
 By Kate Santillan 
 State Sen. Cristina Castro, D-Elgin, will partner with the Illinois Secretary of State to offer a mobile DMV event for City of Elgin residents to complete various Secretary of State driver and vehicle services.
 The event will run from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. Nov. 6 at Elgin Community College’s Building E, 1700 Spartan Drive.
 The mobile DMV offers vehicle registration stickers, driver’s license and state ID renewals, organ donor registration and REAL ID processing. Applicable fees and documentation will be required. To view required documents and fees, visit ilsos.gov .
 “Mobile DMV events provide residents with the opportunity to receive DMV services with ease,” Castro said in a news release. “Spots are limited so I encourage residents to call my office to reserve an appointment.”
 Due to limited space, appointments are required. To schedule an appointment, call 847-214-8864.
